The root cause is confirmed: the slice end is off by one.

args.root_cause: In `paginate()`, the slice end index is computed as `end = start + page_size - 1` (line 31), but Python slices are end-exclusive, so `items[start:end]` drops the last item of every page. Each page returns only `page_size - 1` items. With page size 5 and 11 items, page 1 yields [1,2,3,4] (missing 5), page 2 yields [6,7,8,9] (missing 10), page 3 yields [11]. The items at positions page_size, 2*page_size, ... (i.e. 5, 10) are never returned on any page, matching the report's "same items go missing at a regular interval" symptom. The correct end is `start + page_size` (or `items[start:start + page_size]`). Note the `-1` also means the last item is dropped on a full final page, and the total_pages/has_next logic is correct and unaffected.
